name: trellis
description: Real-time collaborative canvas with Yjs, PostgreSQL, Redis and Next.js

scripts.build: pnpm run packages:build && turbo run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run packages:build && turbo run dev
scripts.db:seed: pnpm run packages:build && pnpm --filter @trellis/api run seed
scripts.test: pnpm run packages:build && turbo run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run packages:build && turbo run typecheck
